title: Checks for imports that are typically imported using a common convention, like import pandas as pd, and enforces that convention.
summary: Consistency is good. Use a common convention for imports to make your code more readable and idiomatic. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-import-conventions and made it stable in v0.0.166.

title: Checks for imports that use non-standard naming conventions, like import tensorflow.keras.backend as K.
summary: Consistency is good. Avoid using a non-standard naming convention for imports, and, in particular, choosing import aliases that violate PEP 8. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-import-conventions and made it stable in v0.0.262.

title: Checks for member imports that should instead be accessed by importing the module.
summary: Consistency is good. Use a common convention for imports to make your code more readable and idiomatic. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-import-conventions and made it stable in v0.0.263.
message_templates: Members of `{}` should not be imported explicitly
